purpose: Prioritize already location-eligible Bratislava-area jobs by practical commute burden without weakening the hard location gate.

outputs.commuteMinutesEstimate: optional; only when routing evidence is available
outputs.commuteKmEstimate: optional; only when routing evidence is available

failClosed.noRoutingEvidence: keep eligible job; do not invent minutes or distance
failClosed.distantHybridDetected: return to location validation; never treat as commute penalty
